Short answers:
- For quarter forecasting, finance will treat this as "probable" only if we have a signed PO or a documented legal signoff. Soft verbal commit will be included in a separate high-confidence watchlist but not in the official quarter numbers.
- Net 45 is acceptable, but we need the PO to include billing start date and any ramp credits called out explicitly.
- If we receive PO by tomorrow 5pm PT and it matches the contract template, we can include 75% of ARR for pacing in the close call, pending cash-collection timing.

Action items:
- Ben/Marissa: update the commit matrix with the expected PO ETA (field: procurement_eta) and set HubSpot "Forecast" to "Watch / PO Pending" if the PO is still outstanding at EOD.
- Priyom: mark dependencies that would push revenue recognition into next quarter (implementation delays, integration milestones).

I will stand by and review the incoming PO immediately.
